text:
Lina (Design): quick sync on a few console nits: button vertical rhythm, table action width, and modal close hit targets.
Owen (Frontend): saw QA screenshot. When `--spacing-dense` is enabled action icons shift ~6px left.
Priya (A11y): icon-only table buttons missing aria-labels; focus ring clipped when parent has `overflow:hidden`.
Marco (Product): users report accidental modal closes on touch—the X is too small. Need bigger hit area without changing visual size.
Lina (Design): principles: 1) consistent baseline grid; 2) icon-only controls must have 44px touch targets; 3) focus-visible must not be clipped.
Owen (Frontend): our tokens are inconsistent: `--space-2` is 6px in legacy set, 8px in new set. I'll normalize tokens and add `--space-dense`.
Priya (A11y): avoid using `transform` on parent containers for focusable items, or render focus via inset box-shadow on control.
Lina (Design): CSS for icon-only button (visual 16px, hit 44px):
```css
.icon-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:44px; height:44px; padding:0; border-radius:8px; }
.icon-btn__visual { width:16px; height:16px; pointer-events:none; }
.icon-btn:focus-visible { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus); }
```
Owen (Frontend): will add wrapper to keep visual icon centered and set action column `min-width:88px` with mobile fallback 56px; will implement modal-close pseudo-element to expand hit area.
Lina (Design): suggest tokens `--hit-target-sm` and `--hit-target-md` and document usage.
design-bot: RFC #5091 may rename tokens; watch for conflicts. https://git.mock/rfc/5091
Marco (Product): acceptance: touch targets >=44px, focus rings visible, table actions aligned, no regressions at common widths.
Priya (A11y): tests: keyboard-only navigation, high-contrast, VoiceOver announces "More actions" for kebab menu.
Owen (Frontend): will open PR with visual diffs tomorrow morning.
Lina (Design): will update component spec and docs copy (sentence case). :sparkles:
